description: This file contains PHP code for managing creation, editing, deletion, and movement of test containers such as test suites and test projects within the TestLink open source testing management system. It includes functions for handling user actions, initializing web editors, managing test cases and test suites, and rendering templates for user interface interactions.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: Generic PHP object used for various configurations and data containers.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes request arguments for test container operations.

methods.name: writeCustomFieldsToDB
methods.description: Saves custom field values for a test suite into the database.

methods.name: deleteTestSuite
methods.description: Handles deletion of a test suite, including confirmation and dependency checks.

methods.name: addTestSuite
methods.description: Creates a new test suite and assigns keywords and custom fields.

methods.name: moveTestSuite
methods.description: Moves a test suite to a new parent container.

methods.name: updateTestSuite
methods.description: Updates the properties of an existing test suite.

methods.name: copyTestSuite
methods.description: Copies a test suite to another container, including its keywords and order.

methods.name: moveTestSuiteViewer
methods.description: Prepares data for displaying the move test suite interface.

methods.name: reorderTestSuiteViewer
methods.description: Prepares data for displaying the reorder test suite interface.

methods.name: initializeOptionTransfer
methods.description: Prepares configuration for transferring options/keywords between test entities.

methods.name: moveTestCasesViewer
methods.description: Prepares data for moving test cases between test suites.

methods.name: copyTestCases
methods.description: Copies selected test cases to another test suite.

methods.name: moveTestCases
methods.description: Moves selected test cases to another test suite.

methods.name: initWebEditors
methods.description: Initializes web editor components for editing test suite details.

methods.name: deleteTestCasesViewer
methods.description: Prepares data for deleting test cases, including dependency checks.

methods.name: doDeleteTestCases
methods.description: Performs deletion of specified test cases.

methods.name: reorderTestCasesByCriteria
methods.description: Reorders test cases based on configured criteria.

methods.name: reorderTestCasesDictionary
methods.description: Reorders test cases alphabetically by name.

methods.name: reorderTestCasesByExtID
methods.description: Reorders test cases by external ID.

methods.name: reorderTestSuitesDictionary
methods.description: Reorders test suites alphabetically.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Initializes GUI data structure for test suite management.

methods.name: doBulkSet
methods.description: Applies bulk updates to multiple test cases.

methods.name: initTPLActions
methods.description: Initializes template actions and associated templates.

methods.name: showTestSuite
methods.description: Displays the test suite management interface.
